incident-bot: [ALERT] KV_CACHE_ERROR_RATE spike on prod-serving-cluster-3 · 2415004321
incident-bot: symptom: continuous-batching requests seeing kv cache reuse mismatches -> stale seq offsets, increased decoding errors (500) · early detection threshold crossed

alexa (oncall): seeing this in the console — traces show repeated reuse of kv pages with wrong seq_offset header. tagging eng-runtime + eng-sre. paging now.

kamal: ack. i'm pulling logs from the affected pods, looks like cache.entries[page_id] is being reused across request contexts when sequence length != cached_seq_len.

josh: can someone post a minimal repro trace? i want the request ids.

eva: pasting a short extract:
```
[2026-03-15T02:12:45Z] req=ci:7f9a kv_page=45 seq_offset=128 expected_seq=0 got_seq=64 decode_error=true
[2026-03-15T02:12:45Z] req=ci:7f9b kv_page=45 seq_offset=128 expected_seq=128 got_seq=0 decode_error=true
```

maria: that looks like stale values from previous inference being returned for new requests. high customer error volume for a set of multi-turn chat workloads.

alexa (oncall): initial customer impact: 12 sessions flagged, ~2.1k requests failed with 500 in last 12m, top impacted region: us-west-2. notifying CS.

ops-runner: rolling mitigation suggestion: temporarily disable continuous batching on the prod-serving pool to prevent cross-request kv reuse. can toggle via runtime-config: `continuous_batching.enabled=false`

kamal: agree. also we should reduce batch_size and short-circuit prefix cache for multi-turn requests. quick patch: set `batch.max_tokens=256` and `kv_cache.prefetch_pages=0` until we have a fix.

josh: i'm ready to apply. is there an automated config rollout?

alexa (oncall): yes. use the internal config API:
```
PATCH https://config.internal.api/runtime/prod-serving-cluster-3
Body: {"continuous_batching.enabled": false, "batch.max_tokens": 256, "kv_cache.prefetch_pages": 0}
```

sre-bot: deploy plan created by alexa (oncall). Canarying to pool node group pg-3-canary (3 nodes) -> 07:25 UTC.

eva: applied patch to canary group. monitoring error rate and p50/p99 latency.

kamal: logs on canary show immediate drop in cross-request seq mismatch errors. good sign.

maria: CS update: sent proactive note to 3 affected customers, asking if they'd like us to rollback to previous model variant while we fix. customers acknowledged, one requested immediate fallback.

ops-runner: starting progressive rollout to remaining nodes (batch) — will pause if error rate > 10% of current or latency bump > 20%.

josh: while rollout proceeds i'm instrumenting more assertions in kv cache refs to catch reuse at allocation time. small hotfix: avoid reassigning page->owner until seq_offset validated. i'll push a hotfix branch.

kamal: can you also add a temporary metric kv_page_reuse_detected to alert if reuse occurs? helps if this recurs.

josh: pushed hotfix branch and created PR #4928: add seq_offset guard + metric emission. running unit + integration tests now.

alexa (oncall): rollout reached 80% nodes, error rate down 92% vs peak, p99 latency back to normal. can we start incident timeline + customer impact summary?

maria: initial summary: incident started 02:12 UTC, peak error rate at 02:18 UTC, ~2.1k failed requests, 3 customers reported visible failures; mitigation: disabled continuous batching + reduced batch size at 02:27 UTC, progressive rollout completed 02:41 UTC.

sre-bot: PR #4928 passed CI and integration canary. recommending hotfix merge to main and staged deploy to prod at low traffic window.

josh: merged hotfix to main at 03:05 UTC. scheduled restart for prod-serving-cluster-3 worker pods (rolling) to pick up binary change.

ops-runner: rolling restart started 03:20 UTC. will monitor for kv reuse metric and decode_error counts.

kamal: after binary rollout, observed kv_page_reuse_detected=0 and no seq mismatch logs for 35m. looks good.

alexa (oncall): handover: i'm on call for another hour, then josh will take over monitoring. action items assigned: (1) eng-runtime: root cause postmortem + design doc for cache ownership model (josh, kamal) (2) eng-sre: add e2e regression test for multi-turn prefix reuse (alexa, eva) (3) product/CS: customer follow-ups and credits as needed (maria).

maria: CS will send final impact note and offer credits.

josh: follow-up notes — we should change default continuous-batching.selection_policy to avoid grouping requests with differing prefix_seq_len. adding to PR backlog.

alexa (oncall): closing the active page; will convert to incident report in incidents channel and link to this thread. thanks all :clap: :heart: 

incident-bot: Incident auto-close check: errors stable for 45m, marking as resolved in alerting dashboard.

alexa (oncall): resolved. handing to josh for overnight watch.

josh: ack, will monitor dashboards overnight and pick up the postmortem tomorrow.
